content.title: Is Target Open or Closed on Easter? What to Know for 2026
content.text: Is Target Open on Easter? Details on 2026 Holiday Hours Will the bullseye retailer be welcoming customers on Sunday, April 5? Here's what to know this year.April 4, 2026, 2:00 PM CDTWill Target be open or closed on Easter 2026? What to know for Sunday, April 5.SOPA Images / Getty ImagesCreate your free account or log in to save this articleEaster has officially arrived. Whether you're spending the day with loved ones or getting outside to enjoy some spring weather, a trip to Target might be on your to-do list.If that's the case, you may be wondering if Target is open on Easter this year. Given that Easter is one of the biggest commemorations on the Christian calendar, many businesses, retailers, restaurants and stores are closed in observance of the April holiday. Included among them are retail giants like Costco, Aldi and Lowe's. But what about Target? Are stores open for business on Sunday, April 5?For the latest on Target's Easter hours, TODAY.com reached out to the bullseye retailer for the most up-to-date information on whether or not locations will be welcoming customers this Easter.See below to find details on Target's plans, as well as a roundup of stores that will be open and closed on Easter to ensure that whatever you're planning to do this Sunday, you've got everything need to make it a great day.A spokesperson tells TODAY.com that Target stores will be closed on Easter this Sunday. Doors will reopen for business as usual on Monday, April 6.To confirm store hours at a Target near you, check the store locator, which you'll find right here. Stores Open on Easter 2026While Target stores will be closed on Sunday, April 5, a variety of other retailers and grocers are welcoming customers this Easter. See below for a sampling or find a complete list right here. BJ’s Wholesale Club: A majority of BJ’s clubs will be open on Easter from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. BJ’s recommends confirming local hours before going.
